# Third-party notices

Lodestar is built from its own code plus the open-source work listed here. As far as we know
every part below allows redistribution (the one open point is noted at the ROM identification
database); the notices and licence texts they ask for are reproduced in this file. The same text is built into the app (menu → About Lodestar → Credits).

This file is generated by `tools/gen-third-party-notices.py` from `Cargo.lock` and the files
in `tools/third-party/`. Do not edit it by hand: change those files and run `python3 -I
tools/gen-third-party-notices.py` again (a test fails when a library is missing).

## Fonts built into Lodestar

| Font | Where it is used | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| LodestarSymbols (a subset of DejaVu Sans 2.37: arrows, shapes, punctuation, Latin / Greek / Cyrillic) | symbols in every font family, so they never show as boxes | Bitstream Vera licence + Arev fonts licence; DejaVu changes are public domain (full text below, "Bitstream-Vera", and in `assets/fonts/LodestarSymbols-LICENSE.txt`). Renamed as the licences ask: no "Bitstream", "Vera" or "Arev" in its name. |
| Titillium Web (Light, Regular, SemiBold, Bold; unmodified, `assets/fonts/titillium-web/`) | Playnite's own typeface, for imported Playnite themes and the "Top Bar" layout | SIL Open Font License 1.1, © 2009-2011 Accademia di Belle Arti di Urbino and students of MA course of Visual design (full text in `assets/fonts/titillium-web/OFL.txt`; no Reserved Font Name declared) |
| Ubuntu Light | egui's default text font | Ubuntu Font Licence 1.0 |
| Hack | egui's default monospace font | MIT (Hack changes) + Bitstream Vera licence |
| Noto Emoji | egui's emoji fallback | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| emoji-icon-font (and egui's 5-glyph subset of it) | egui's icon glyphs | MIT, Copyright (c) 2014 John Slegers |

The egui fonts come with the `epaint_default_fonts` library; their notices are under "Extra
notices" below.

## Data built into Lodestar

| Data | Origin | Licence / terms |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Platform list (85 consoles and computers: ids, names, IGDB ids, database names) | Playnite's `Platforms.yaml`, with a few data fixes and one added platform (`arcade`) | MIT, Copyright (c) 2020 Josef Nemec (notice below) |
| ROM identification database (`assets/emulation/romdb.bin`: game names, regions, years, serials and CRC checksums per console) | Converted from Playnite's emulation databases by `scripts/gen-romdb.py`. Playnite built them from the public DAT files of No-Intro, Redump, GameTDB and the libretro-database project. | Playnite: MIT (notice below). The DAT groups publish their lists freely; libretro-database is CC BY-SA 4.0. The DAT groups do not state redistribution terms for their lists in one place. |
| Playnite's default Desktop and Fullscreen themes (`assets/playnite/default-theme.bin`: their resource dictionaries, derived styles and views, which imported Playnite themes inherit every file they don't ship from) | Playnite's open-source default themes (`Themes/Desktop/Default`, `Themes/Fullscreen/Default`), comments removed, compressed by `tools/gen-playnite-defaults.py` | MIT, Copyright (c) 2020 Josef Nemec (notice below) |
| The "Top Bar" controller layout (`assets/themes/top-bar.toml`, called "Playnite Classic" before 0.16.3) | Lodestar's own drawing, arranged after Playnite's default Fullscreen theme (`Views/Main.xaml`, `Views/GameDetails.xaml`, `DerivedStyles/ListGameItemStyle.xaml`: bar heights, positions, focus look) | MIT, Copyright (c) 2020 Josef Nemec (notice below) |
| Emulator knowledge (where emulators are installed, how they start games, folder names of ROM collections) | Written for Lodestar from the emulators' own documentation, Flathub manifests, Playnite's emulator definitions and ES-DE's find rules | Facts only, no files copied. Playnite and ES-DE: MIT (notices below). |
| BIOS / firmware list (file names, checksums and regions used to check BIOS files) | Collected for Lodestar from libretro's `System.dat` (libretro-database), DuckStation's and Batocera's BIOS lists and the emulators' documentation | Facts only, no files copied. libretro-database: CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| Controller mappings (SDL_GameControllerDB) | Built in by the `gilrs` library | zlib licence (notice under "Extra notices") |
| Trusted certificate authorities for secure connections | Mozilla's CA list, built in by the `webpki-roots` library | CDLA-Permissive-2.0 |
| Unicode character data | Built in by the `unicode-ident` / `unicode-properties` libraries | Unicode Licence v3 |
| SQLite database engine | Built in by the `libsqlite3-sys` library (`bundled`) | Public domain (notice under "Extra notices") |
| Device icons (`assets/platforms/*.svg`), the Lodestar icon and the built-in themes | Made for Lodestar | Lodestar's own |

### ES-DE (EmulationStation Desktop Edition)

Lodestar's ROM folder names and some of the places it looks for emulators follow ES-DE's
system list and find rules (https://es-de.org): facts only, no ES-DE files are included.

```
MIT License

Copyright (c) 2024-2026 Northwestern Software AB
Copyright (c) 2020-2024 Leon Styhre
Copyright (c) 2014 Alec Lofquist

(The MIT licence text is the one under "Licence texts" below.)
```

## Online services

Lodestar can ask these services for artwork and game information. Each can be switched off
in Settings → Metadata; the ones that need a key (your own, free) are only asked once you add
it. Their content belongs to them and their contributors.

| Service | What Lodestar asks it | Site |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Steam store | game details, artwork | https://store.steampowered.com |
| SteamGridDB | artwork | https://www.steamgriddb.com |
| IGDB (Twitch) | game details, artwork | https://www.igdb.com |
| GOG | artwork | https://www.gog.com |
| TheGamesDB | artwork | https://thegamesdb.net |
| libretro-thumbnails | box art and screenshots for console games | https://github.com/libretro-thumbnails |
| Lutris.net | artwork | https://lutris.net |
| PCGamingWiki | cover art | https://www.pcgamingwiki.com |
| ProtonDB | how well a game runs on Linux | https://www.protondb.com |
| Wikipedia | game descriptions (text under CC BY-SA 4.0) | https://www.wikipedia.org |
| GameTDB | covers for Wii / GameCube / DS / 3DS games | https://www.gametdb.com |
| RomM | games on your own RomM server | https://romm.app |

Game names, console names, store names and logos are trademarks of their owners. Lodestar is
not affiliated with or endorsed by any of them.
